proof_body:
by
  intro G H _ _ I
  obtain ⟨G', H', M, N, hM, hN, e, he⟩ := I.goursat
  refine ⟨G', H', M, N, hM, hN, e, fun g h => ?_⟩
  rw [he]
  simp [Subgroup.mem_map, MonoidHom.mem_graph]
target_source: ∀ (G H : Type*) [Group G] [Group H] (I : Subgroup (G × H)), ∃ (G' : Subgroup G) (H' : Subgroup H) (M : Subgroup G') (N : Subgroup H') (_ : M.Normal) (_ : N.Normal) (e : G' ⧸ M ≃* H' ⧸ N), ∀ (g : G) (h : H), (g, h) ∈ I ↔ ∃ (hg : g ∈ G') (hh : h ∈ H'), e ((⟨g, hg⟩ : G') : G' ⧸ M) = ((⟨h, hh⟩ : H') : H' ⧸ N)
